name: Plenum Security Cable, White, 22/4 (22 AWG 4 Conductor), Stranded, CMP, Pullbox, 1000 foot
description: Use this bulk plenum security cable to pre-wire a home or business for security systems. Plenum rated means this cable can be run in the area of a building between floors that is used to circulate air. The plenum rating refers to the material used in the jacket of the cable. This material has a lower burn rating and burns less than non-plenum cables.
